AGENDA
  SENIOR SERVICES COMMITTEE MEETING
  ADULT RECREATION CENTER
  201 E. Colorado St.
  Glendale, CA 91205
Welcome to the meeting of the Senior Services Committee. Meetings are open to the public and
held at the Adult Recreation Center at 201 E. Colorado Street, Glendale, CA 91205. Meeting
minutes will be available for viewing on the City Website at
https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal. If you have any questions about
matters on the agenda or requests for assistance, please contact (818) 548-3715 during regular
business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES DURING THE MEETING.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks
Administration Office, 633 E. Broadway, Room 305, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the
Community Services & Parks Administration Office at (818) 548-2782, at least 72 hours prior to the
scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive
use of City provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own
interpreter or speak in their native language.
  AUGUST 23, 2023 AT 2:30 PM

 1.  ROLL CALL
  a.  Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the August
  23, 2023, quarterly meeting of the Senior Services Committee Meeting was posted on
  or before Friday, August 18, 2023, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

 2.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a.  Introduction of 2023-2024 Senior Services Committee members

 3.  CONSENT ITEMS
   a.  Approval of the Minutes of the July 13, 2022, Senior Services Committee
  Quarterly Meeting.

4.  COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

5.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5)
  minutes. The Committee may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Director or designee may refer the matter to the proper section for investigation and
  report.

6.  ACTION ITEMS
  a.  Report regarding Schedule for FY 2023-2024 Senior Services Committee
  Meetings
  1. Motion to approve Senior Services Committee Meeting Schedule for FY 2023-2024.
  b.  Selection of Senior Services Committee Officers
  1. Selection of Chair for the term August 2023-August 2024
  2. Selection of Vice-Chair for the term August 2023-August 2024

7.  REPORTS - INFORMATION ONLY
  a.  Senior Needs Assessment 2023 Update
  b.  Senior Programs and Events Update

8.  ADJOURNMENT
